title: Module-level finding reported as proven unreachable
code_snippet:
$ govulncheck -scan module ./...
=== Module Results ===

Vulnerability #1: GO-2024-0007
  Module: example.com/alpha
    Found in: example.com/alpha@v1.3.0

Your code may be affected by 1 vulnerability.

# Auditor's report:
# "Not called — your code is NOT affected. Closing as a false positive."
expected_feedback: A module-level scan cannot establish reachability, so the absence of an E1 tier means 'not measured', not 'not reachable'. This is no-reachability mode: report the E3 Required tier actually obtained, at P3, and state that reachability was never assessed. Re-run with -scan symbol to measure it. 'Your code is NOT affected' is also not a string govulncheck v1.x emits.
